notes.notes:

-	Info Library update pop-up is now just 1 pop-up rather than specifically telling you what updated
-	Minor alterations to a few lines
-	Fixed a few minor bugs with the timeline and discussion sections

notes.title: Demo Update v1.12

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
The demo build has been updated!

[list]
[*] MAJOR Update for the final discussion section!! New discussion features have been introduced which will hopefully make these sections feel more engaging! Do check it out and let me know what you think because this could greatly influence the future discussion sections
[*] Fixed some minor bugs with using the Timeline
[*] Fixed a bug so now Endings 1 and 2 will finally play in the right order (trying to keep this explanation spoiler free as possible)
[*] Added toggle for VA
[*] Added version to the opening screen of the demo
[/list]

Saves that are in the middle of the final discussion may not work properly, but all other saves should work just fine. If you've already played and would just like to test the updates, go to any investigation section and enter the timeline, then pick the last discussion on the bottom right branch. 

Enjoy!
